description.para: Register offsets within a Mutex, there are multiple Mutexes within a single device

detaileddescription.para: Set to 1 indicates that the lock is currently owned by the processor ID specified by the CPU_ID (OWNER_MASK) in this register. Set to 0 indicates that the lock is free.
CPU_ID indicates the ID the processor holding the lock.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMutex instance to be worked on.
Device configuration structure containing required HW build data.
Physical address of the hardware in a Virtual Memory operating system environment. It is the Base Address in a stand alone environment.

briefdescription.para: Locks a Mutex within a Mutex device.

detaileddescription.para: Locks a particular Mutex lock within a Mutex device. Call blocks till the Mutex is locked.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMutex instance to be worked on.
Specific Mutex lock within the device to operate on. Each device may contain multiple Mutex locks. The Mutex number is a zero based number with a range of 0 - (InstancePtr->Config.NumMutex - 1).

listitem.para: XMutex_Lock blocks until the caller gets the lock.
Use XMutex_Trylock for a non-blocking call. The caller gets the lock if it is available and returns immediately if the lock is not available.

briefdescription.para: Tries to lock a Mutex without blocking.

detaileddescription.para: Locks a particular Mutex lock within a Mutex device. Call returns immediately if the Mutex is already locked (This is Non-Blocking call).

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMutex instance to be worked on.
Specific Mutex lock within the device to operate on. Each device may contain multiple Mutex locks. The Mutex number is a zero based number with a range of 0 - (InstancePtr->Config.NumMutex - 1).

listitem.para: XST_DEVICE_BUSY if the Mutex was found to be already locked.
This is a non-blocking call. The caller gets the lock if it is available. Otherwise, XST_DEVICE_BUSY is returned.
Use XMutex_Lock if you need to block until a lock is obtained.

briefdescription.para: Unlocks a Mutex within a Mutex device.

detaileddescription.para: Unlocks a particular Mutex lock within a Mutex device.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMutex instance to be worked on.
Specific Mutex lock within the device to operate on. Each device may contain multiple Mutex locks. The Mutex number is a zero based number with a range of 0 - (InstancePtr->Config.NumMutex - 1).

listitem.para: XST_FAILURE if the Mutex was locked by process with different ID.

briefdescription.para: Returns whether a Mutex is locked.

detaileddescription.para: Gets the current lock state of a Mutex lock within a Mutex device.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMutex instance to be worked on.
Specific Mutex lock within the device to operate on. Each device may contain multiple Mutex locks. The Mutex number is a zero based number with a range of 0 - (InstancePtr->Config.NumMutex - 1).

briefdescription.para: Gets the lock status and owner of a Mutex.

detaileddescription.para: Gets the current status of a Mutex lock within a Mutex device.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMutex instance to be worked on.
Specific Mutex lock within the device to operate on. Each device may contain multiple Mutex locks. The Mutex number is a zero based number with a range of 0 - (InstancePtr->Config.NumMutex - 1).
Pointer where the current lock status is stored. Sets memory pointed to by 'Locked' to 1 if the Mutex is locked and 0 if it is unlocked.
Pointer where the current owner status is stored. If the Mutex is locked, the memory pointed to by 'Owner' is updated to reflect the CPU ID that has currently locked this Mutex.

briefdescription.para: Reads the USER register of a Mutex.

detaileddescription.para: Gets the USER register of a Mutex lock within a Mutex device.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMutex instance to be worked on.
Specific Mutex lock within the device to operate on. Each device may contain multiple Mutex locks. The Mutex number is a zero based number with a range of 0 - (InstancePtr->Config.NumMutex - 1).
Pointer to an u32 where the current user register value is stored by this function.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful. Memory pointed to by User is updated to reflect the contents of the user register.
XST_NO_FEATURE if the Mutex was not configured with a USER register.

briefdescription.para: Writes the USER register of a Mutex.

detaileddescription.para: Sets the USER register of a Mutex lock within a Mutex device.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMutex instance to be worked on.
Specific Mutex lock within the device to operate on. Each device may contain multiple Mutex locks. The Mutex number is a zero based number with a range of 0 - (InstancePtr->Config.NumMutex - 1).
Value to update the USER register with.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the USER register is written with the given value .
XST_NO_FEATURE if the Mutex was not configured with a USER register.

briefdescription.para: Runs a destructive self-test on a Mutex core.

detaileddescription.para: Selftest a particular Mutex hardware core.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XMutex instance to be worked on.

listitem.para: XST_FAILURE if test was not successful.

simplesect.para: This test is destructive. It fails if the Mutex is currently being used. This is also a blocking call, if there is another process which has the Mutex, the first lock hangs the test until the other process releases it.

briefdescription.para: Looks up Mutex configuration by device ID or base address.

detaileddescription.para: Looks up the device configuration based on the unique device ID/BaseAddress. The XMutex_ConfigTable[] contains the configuration info for each device in the system.

parameterdescription.para: Contains the base address of the device.

simplesect.para: A pointer to the configuration found or NULL if the specified device ID/BaseAddress was not found. See xmutex.h for the definition of XMutex_Config.
In XSCT/classic flow, DeviceId is used to look up the device configuration.

briefdescription.para: Reads one of the Mutex registers.

detaileddescription.para: Read one of the Mutex registers.

parameterdescription.para: Contains the base address of the Mutex device.
Contains the specific Mutex within the device, a zero based number, 0 - (NumMutexConfigured in HW - 1).
Contains the offset from the 1st register of the Mutex to select the specific register of the Mutex.

simplesect.para: The 32 bit value read from the register.
C-style signature u32 XMutex_ReadReg(u32 BaseAddress, u8 MutexNumber, unsigned RegOffset)

briefdescription.para: Writes a value to a Mutex register.

detaileddescription.para: Write a specified value to a register of a Mutex.

parameterdescription.para: Base address of the Mutex device.
Specific Mutex within the device, a zero based number, 0 - (NumMutexConfigured in HW - 1).
Contains the offset from the 1st register of the Mutex to select the specific register of the Mutex.
32 bit value to be written to the register.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XMutex_WriteReg(u32 BaseAddress, u8 MutexNumber, unsigned RegOffset, u32 ValueToWrite)
